newsitem.title: SPAIN: Nine-year-old girl and sisters in Spain bank heist.
newsitem.headline: Nine-year-old girl and sisters in Spain bank heist.

text.p: Spanish police arrested four sisters aged between nine and 14 after they robbed a bank in the northern city of Burgos, making off with 1.34 million pesetas ($10,400), officials said on Wednesday.
The girls, from central Spain, distracted the bank manager and a teller while the youngest slipped into a booth and stole the money.
A bank employee chased and caught them after realising what had happened. But police failed to recover the money and believe an adult waiting outside the bank made off with the loot.
